description: Session and incident records: session logs (Freebuff dumps, orchestrator debug), postmortems, error memory (recurring error → known fix), and cross-session handoff documents. Use when starting/ending a session needs a record, an incident needs a postmortem, or work must continue in another session without losing context. One contract; the parts under parts/ carry the procedures.
